# Stone

Type: Material | Internal ID: Stone | Source: Stones,, Greydwarf, ,, Greydwarf brute, ,, Stone Golem | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Stone is a basic resource. It can be used as a material to build structures with the hammer, or craft weapons and tools from the Workbench and the Forge.

## Availability

• Scavenging stones scattered on the ground. They do not respawn.
• Mining larger chunks of stone, Copper deposits and Silver veins with a pickaxe.
• Dropped by Greydwarf, Greydwarf brute and Stone Golem.

### Crafting

• Hammer
• Hoe
• Sharpening stone
• Stone axe

### Terraforming

• Laying Paved road with a Hoe.
• Raising the ground level with a Hoe.
